goal: Decide the next status of one escrow in the PrismPM Vault studio from the operation applied to it, so locking, release and refund can be replayed step by step.

app.name: vault-escrow-lifecycle
app.title: Vault escrow lifecycle
app.purpose: Decide the next status of one escrow agreement from its status, the operation, the depositor funds, the preimage and the epochs.

fields.name: state
fields.means: the escrow status now; none means it has not been locked

fields.name: event
fields.means: the Vault operation applied: LockEscrow, ReleaseEscrow or RefundEscrow

fields.name: funds
fields.means: whether the depositor balance covers a positive amount

fields.name: preimage
fields.means: whether a condition preimage is supplied with a release

fields.name: timeout
fields.means: the epoch at which the escrow expires

meanings.none: no escrow is locked and no funds are held
meanings.active: the amount is locked and counted in totalEscrowLocked
meanings.released: the amount went to the beneficiary; the escrow is settled
meanings.refunded: the amount went back to the depositor after timeout; the escrow is settled

rules.why: src/model/engine.ts: an escrow whose status is not active answers already released
src/model/engine.ts: an escrow whose status is not active answers already refunded
src/model/engine.ts LockEscrow: a positive amount within the depositor balance is locked as active
src/model/engine.ts: release and refund answer escrow-not-found; a lock without funds answers insufficient-funds or invalid-amount
src/model/engine.ts ReleaseEscrow: conditionMatch holds for any non-empty preimage
src/model/engine.ts RefundEscrow: currentEpoch below timeoutEpoch answers escrow-not-expired

app.otherwiseWhy: an empty preimage is a condition mismatch, an early refund is escrow-not-expired, and a lock creates a separate escrow

properties.why: src/model/engine.ts: refund is unavailable until timeout
src/model/engine.ts: an empty preimage does not satisfy the condition hash
src/model/vaultSource.ts balanceNonNegativity: no lock exceeds the balance

stakeholders.name: Depositor
stakeholders.text: Locks funds for a beneficiary and needs them back after timeout, and never twice.

stakeholders.name: Beneficiary
stakeholders.text: Receives the escrow on release and needs a refund impossible before the timeout epoch.

concerns.name: Settled once
concerns.text: A released or refunded escrow is never released or refunded again.

components.name: PrismPM Model and Runtime Studio
components.text: The Vite studio that runs the Vault engine, the simulated build pipeline and the proof verifier in the browser.

components.name: PrismPM toolchain
components.text: The prismpm check, lexlean build, codegen and holo compose stages the studio simulates for the Vault model.

threats.name: Any preimage releases
threats.text: A caller releases an escrow with any non-empty preimage, since the engine does not compare it with the condition hash.
threats.accepted: This mirrors src/model/engine.ts as it is: conditionMatch holds for any non-empty preimage. The studio is a simulation, and a real hash check belongs to the LexLean Vault source it models.

threats.name: Early refund
threats.text: A depositor refunds an active escrow before its timeout epoch.

control.name: Timeout guard
control.text: Refund leaves active only at or after the timeout epoch.

threats.name: Double settlement
threats.text: A settled escrow is released or refunded again, paying its amount twice.

control.name: Final states
control.text: Released and refunded are final and never left; the builder derives and proves both invariants from machine.final.

quality.text: An active escrow is refunded only when the epoch has reached its timeout.
quality.measureText: Requests with epoch below timeout that refund an active escrow.

quality.text: No event moves a released or refunded escrow to another status.
quality.measure: Transitions out of a final state
quality.measureText: Requests in a final state that answer a different state.
